node.title: Re^4: convert encoding
node.author: rumpumpel1
node.doctext: use strict; use Lyo::OSLC::CQ::CM; use Data::Dumper; use Encode qw(encode decode); ... my $client = Lyo::OSLC::CQ::CM->new; ... my $data = $client->oslcWhere(...); # get data from ClearQuest my $xml = Dumper($data); my $xml_out = encode('UTF-8', $xml); print $xml_out;
